tasks.short: Verify database entries and correct errors

steps.what: Establish source versions and accuracy rules for the data batch
Compare database values with specified source values and validation rules
Verify discrepancies and correct errors with an audit trail

tasks.design: Configure reproducible checks in {DATA_PLATFORM} against a source-linked specification. The assistant verifies discrepancies and approves each correction; rule compliance alone does not prove validity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparisons are mixed with source interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native validation rules can produce a traceable discrepancy list.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish a true error from an unusual but valid observation.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous evidence without silently changing research meaning.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical comparison, unchanged responsibility for corrections.

evidence.claim: Castor EDC provides conditional forms and audit trails; that supports configured validation, not automatic scientific validity decisions.
Model knowledge: local comparison savings require usable source data and remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is checking an existing data batch, excluding original participant collection and initial entry.

In s1 the assistant produces batch version, record keys, source references, expected values or permitted domains, missing-value codes and comparison rules. Manual extraction and capture consume the retained 30%; unsupported sources remain manual. s2 never assumes a pre-existing discrepancy code.
Test native validation before custom checks. Existing automatic checks earn no new labour saving.
Correction review is distinct from initial entry; assign overlapping checks once across tasks.
unknowns: Source accessibility and existing validation coverage
research_questions: How many errors depend on meaning rather than equality or range checks?

incremental.description: Rule upkeep and recurring exception audit

approvals.approved_version: Exact batch, record, field, old and new values, source reference and correction reason reviewed before write; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+35=65; gross=35, incremental=8, net=27. Range 0-12 allows existing validation or source extraction to consume most comparison gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and implement research quality control procedures

steps.what: Develop research quality control procedures and implement them against study risks

tasks.design: Keep selection and implementation of study controls with the assistant under existing investigator oversight. Use {DOCS} and native {DATA_PLATFORM} facilities; routine execution of a defined data check belongs to the separate checking task.
tasks.previous_blocker: A control must address the study's actual failure modes rather than a generic checklist.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing study records and native validation facilities support procedure development.
tasks.still_hard: Show that a control catches meaningful errors without biasing the study.
tasks.human_edge: Judge which errors matter and when a procedure needs revision.
tasks.altitude: Control design duties and investigator authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess a proposed questionnaire quality check

evidence.claim: Castor EDC offers conditional logic and audit trails; it does not establish which quality controls a particular social science study needs.

assumptions: Boundary is study-specific control development and implementation, excluding repeated data checking counted under task 12956.

The investigator supplies the existing protocol and required authorisation before implementation; the assistant elicits failure patterns, expected behaviour and test examples within s1. No structured approved-control flag is assumed. Ambiguous requirements return to the investigator within retained work.
Test native configuration first; no additional automation is proposed because a separable repetitive baseline is unknown.
Incremental upkeep is zero because procedure work and current tooling remain unchanged; formal investigator approval remains an existing outside duty with no saving claimed.
unknowns: Study governance and whether the assistant configures or only recommends controls
research_questions: Is there repeated procedure transcription distinct from scientific control design?

already_counted.description: Study-specific design, clarification and implementation checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0, net=0. New studies and revised protocols retain procedure judgement and implementation work; repeated check execution is counted elsewhere.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Specify database transformations, source versions and access limits
Prepare and manipulate databases using specified joins, recodes and derived fields
Review transformed databases and release the approved internal version

tasks.design: Run specified, versioned transformations in {DATA_PLATFORM} instead of repeating manual manipulation. Keep semantic mapping, access decisions and release checks with the assistant.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated database operations may depend on undocumented mappings.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned deterministic pipelines can execute explicit mappings reproducibly.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve changes in field meaning and prevent mistaken record linkage.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a valid join is scientifically wrong.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated manipulation; unchanged data stewardship and access authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit research data transformations can be run as deterministic code; local labour savings depend on existing pipeline coverage.

assumptions: Boundary is transformation and database management after initial entry; source accuracy checking belongs to task 12956.

The assistant produces source versions, keys, schemas, join cardinalities, recodes, missing-value handling, derivation formulas and permitted output fields in s1. Manual mapping and capture retain 35%. Missing definitions stop the run and return to manual specification, never inferred linkage.
Study collection produces raw datasets before this task; no new collection work is transferred. s2 uses only the s1 specification and stages outputs without overwriting originals.
Test native database jobs first. Release checks cover transformation fidelity, not duplicated initial data validation.
unknowns: Current scheduled transformations and permission model
research_questions: How much manipulation is repeated unchanged between research batches?

already_counted.description: Output lineage, join and semantic checks before release

approvals.approved_version: Exact staged dataset hash, source versions, transformation revision, access scope and lineage checked before internal release; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+25=60; gross=40, incremental=9, net=31. Range 0-15 allows existing jobs or frequent semantic schema changes to remove most repeat-run savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Enter research data and complete clerical work

steps.what: Identify authorised project records and capture their data entry mappings
Perform data entry by copying mapped values into project records
Check entry totals, resolve clerical exceptions and commit the batch

tasks.design: Configure {DATA_PLATFORM} imports for verified entry batches from {DOCS}. Keep source interpretation, unsupported clerical work and batch approval human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Record values may be retyped despite being available in reusable form.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports can map verified fields without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve illegible sources, conflicting identifiers and nonstandard clerical requests.
tasks.human_edge: Detect when a copied value has the wrong meaning or destination.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry where present, unchanged project completion responsibility.

reach.task: Clarify a source response before entry

evidence.claim: Castor EDC provides forms with conditional logic and an audit trail; a local import and its mapping still need verification.
Model knowledge: only duplicate entry from reusable verified values is removed in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is initial project entry and clerical completion, excluding subsequent scientific validity checking and database transformation.

The assistant produces source reference, record key, target field, source value, encoding, missing-value code and target schema in s1. All manual reading, capture and mapping stays within 40%; paper or ambiguous records remain manual. s2 cannot assume a free structured response dataset.
The assistant handles rejected rows and other clerical requests in the retained s3 share. Test native import configuration before custom code.
Entry work repeated in task 12952 must have one owner; do not sum both savings for the same copy.
unknowns: Reusable source formats and actual clerical task mix
research_questions: Does source preparation leave enough duplicate typing to justify import upkeep?

already_counted.description: Batch approval and clerical exception handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact staged rows, source references, field mapping, target project and batch totals checked before commit; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+25=65; gross=35, incremental=8, net=27. Range 0-10 allows paper-heavy inputs or an existing import to erase much of the copying gain; other clerical work retains its time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reproducible imports and transformations support the assistant's continued responsibility for source meaning and data corrections.
reach: Explain research dataset lineage and limitations to survey researchers.
role.ambitious_version: A research assistant who can reproduce data preparation without treating rule compliance as scientific validity.
